'Recommended actions (from action codes)

• O-Q3.1 — Quality & Yield Orchestration
  Owner: head_of_quality
  Trigger: quality.fpy.pct < 96.0%
  Impact: High
  Expected: 1.0–3.0 pp
  Confidence: High
  · DETECT sustained FPY deterioration on this production line
  · DIAGNOSE the dominant quality loss driver for this line
  · ACTIVATE the corresponding execution Action Code for this line
  ⚠ Trigger only if throughput impact remains within tolerance
  ⚠ Do not trigger if quality loss is driven by temporary ramp-up

• O-Q3.2 — Process Defect Elimination
  Owner: quality_engineer
  Trigger: quality.defect_density > 0.25%
  Impact: High
  Expected: -20.0–-50.0 %
  Confidence: High
  · IDENTIFY top defect categories and process steps on this production line
  · PERFORM root-cause analysis on dominant defects for this line
  · IMPLEMENT corrective and preventive actions on this line
  ⚠ Trigger only if defect concentration exceeds Pareto threshold
  ⚠ Do not trigger if defects are dominated by external material causes

• O-Q3.3 — Scrap & Rework Reduction
  Owner: production_manager
  Trigger: quality.scrap.pct > 4.0%
  Impact: Medium
  Expected: -0.5–-2.0 pp
  Confidence: Medium
  · IDENTIFY dominant scrap and rework drivers on this production line
  · ANALYSE rework loops and root causes for this line
  · IMPLEMENT process or control corrections on this line
  ⚠ Trigger only if FPY deterioration is confirmed
  ⚠ Do not trigger if scrap increase is short-term mix-driven

• O-Q3.4 — COPQ Reduction
  Owner: head_of_quality
  Trigger: quality.copq.amount > 0.25%
  Impact: High
  Expected: -10.0–-30.0 %
  Confidence: Medium
  · IDENTIFY each production line with rising COPQ
  · RANK COPQ drivers by financial impact for this line
  · ACTIVATE targeted quality actions on top drivers for this line
  ⚠ Trigger only if COPQ increase is structurally recurring
  ⚠ Do not trigger if COPQ spike is driven by isolated recall events

• O-Q3.5 — Complaint-Driven Stabilisation
  Owner: quality_manager
  Trigger: quality.complaint.pct > 0.6%
  Impact: High
  Expected: -20.0–-50.0 %
  Confidence: Medium
  · IDENTIFY products with rising complaint rates on this production line
  · MAP complaints to production defects and processes for this line
  · EXECUTE stabilisation and containment actions on this line
  ⚠ Trigger only if complaint trend is structurally increasing
  ⚠ Do not trigger if complaints are driven by distribution or service issues'
